task: Pick up the CUP and place it on the TABLE.
plan_summary: Navigate robot CAR to the CUP location, pick up the CUP, navigate to the TABLE location, and place the CUP on the TABLE.
assumptions: The CUP is graspable by the robot CAR
Navigating to the exact coordinates of the CUP with tolerance 1.0 will bring the robot within interaction_distance (2.0) of the CUP
After picking the CUP, navigating to the TABLE coordinates with tolerance 1.0 will bring the robot within interaction_distance (2.0) of the TABLE
